messages:
Ava (Billing Analyst): Flagging Skyline Therapeutics invoice 13579 — partner discount was applied in error to an enterprise renewal. Need manual refund + GL correction.
Omar (Partner Success): Oof. That discount was part of a limited partner pilot that should only hit partner-sourced trials, not enterprise renewals. Customer just emailed asking why they got a \u201cPartner10\u201d line item on a 12-month renewal.
Ava (Billing Analyst): Invoice excerpt: ```
Invoice: 13579
Customer: Skyline Therapeutics (US)
Period: 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30
Line: Annual Renewal - Enterprise Plan    $120,000.00
Line: Promo Partner10 (partner pilot)    -$12,000.00
Total: $108,000.00
```
Ava (Billing Analyst): System rule mistakenly matched partner tag because renewal was created by same AM who also handles partner accounts.
Priya (Head of Billing): Two parts: 1) reverse the $12k credit and issue a corrected invoice (debit memo), 2) offer a small goodwill (if needed) to preserve relationship. What's the requested customer outcome?
Omar (Partner Success): Customer wants the correction; they'd prefer not to pay extra but understand it was a mistake. I can offer $1k account credit as a courtesy if approved.
Ava (Billing Analyst): billing-bot, draft credit memo/adjustment to remove the partner promo: CM-2026-980 reverse $12,000 reason=\"erroneous partner pilot promo applied to enterprise renewal\". Also draft goodwill CM-2026-981 for $1,000 reason=\"customer courtesy\". Attach invoice PDF and AM note.
billing-bot: CM-2026-980 created (DRAFT) for $12,000.00. CM-2026-981 created (DRAFT) for $1,000.00. Attachments: invoice_13579.pdf, am_note_omar.eml.
Priya (Head of Billing): Tax check: tax-bot, any sales tax/VAT implications for reversing a promo on an annual contract in MA?
tax-bot: For MA (US), SaaS is not taxable in most cases. This credit reversal increases taxable base only if taxed originally; both invoice and credit are non-taxable here. No sales tax posting required.
Priya (Head of Billing): Approve reversal. Approve up to $2k goodwill without exec signoff, so $1k OK. Ava  upload AM confirmation that customer accepts corrected invoice and $1k credit.
Omar (Partner Success): Uploaded: skyline_acceptance_20260710.eml. Customer agreed to corrected invoice; will accept $1k account credit.
Ava (Billing Analyst): billing-bot, move CM-2026-980 to PENDING_APPROVAL (approver: Priya) and auto-apply CM-2026-981 as goodwill (within threshold).
billing-bot: CM-2026-981 moved to APPROVED and applied as account credit. CM-2026-980 status -> PENDING_APPROVAL (approver: Priya).
Priya (Head of Billing): Approved CM-2026-980. Please include internal memo: \"Erroneous promo application due to partner-tagging rule; marketing flagged for fix MG-2279.\"
Ava (Billing Analyst): billing-bot, finalize CM-2026-980 and post against Invoice 13579. Post GL entries and notify RevOps for recognition impact.
billing-bot: CM-2026-980 moved to APPROVED and applied to Invoice 13579. New invoice balance: $120,000.00. Journal: CRD-2026-980 posted. Revenue flagged for RevOps review (revops-bot tagged).
revops-bot: Noted. Will assess revenue reversal impact and coordinate month-end cut. Expected ARR impact flagged in the Rev Schedule.
Omar (Partner Success): Customer replied: \"Thanks for the quick fix and for the $1k credit. We appreciate the transparency.\" :thumbsup:
Ava (Billing Analyst): Closing thread. Filing CM docs to July month-end bundle and creating follow-up ticket for engineering/marketing to tighten promo rule (MG-2279).
